integrity: Analytical proof uses strict rational and elementary logarithmic inequalities. Reproducible computational witness is illustrative and does not substitute for infinite-domain proof. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Dimension-three mergers are constructed on one symmetric invariant line; no complete three-dimensional preimage census, classification of all later collisions, or conclusion about other escort maps. Non-exhaustive priority search.
title: A sharp dimension-three delayed-coalescence boundary for the self-power escort map
